nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Season One: A Place You Earn. Before the story starts, tell us who you are.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Moving day.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: The old bedroom is nearly empty. A worn soccer ball rides on your lap, and Cloudy's travel tank is buckled in beside you.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Everything we need is in this car. Including the fish.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The ball is enough. It works anywhere.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm keeping the shirt where I can see it.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: A message from back home lights up the phone: "Going to be strange without you."

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Scottsdale.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Through the car window: wide streets, bright light, mountains that look painted on.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: New house, new school, new team. One thing at a time.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: One thing at a time.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: The new bedroom still smells like cardboard. The aquarium is already set up on the desk, a small label on the glass: CLOUDY.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Something orange moves behind the plastic castle, just for a second.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hey, Cloudy. Tomorrow's Monday.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: The first real conversation can wait until then.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Week 1, Monday. Nobody Knows You Here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Everyone already has people here.

nodes.speaker: Cloudy
nodes.text: I have a plastic castle and a snail who refuses to make eye contact. Start small.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What if nobody wants me?

nodes.speaker: Cloudy
nodes.text: Find out who they are before you let them decide who you are.

options.label: I just want to get through today.
I want a chance to play.

nodes.speaker: Cloudy
nodes.text: You can miss it. You still get to have today.

nodes.speaker: Cloudy
nodes.text: Good. What would a fair chance look like? Know that before you ask for it.

nodes.speaker: Cloudy
nodes.text: Then pick one conversation. Just one. A small one. Like me.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Recess. A game is already running at the only goal.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can I play?

nodes.speaker: Blake
nodes.text: Teams are set.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: A moment later Blake waves an arriving friend straight in. Sam sees it and looks away. Riley jogs after a loose ball and rolls it back without joining the teasing.

options.label: Ask when the next game starts

nodes.speaker: Jordan

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good to know.

nodes.text: It's not friendship yet. It's directions.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: You find the empty wall and work on short passes against it. Nobody stops you.

nodes.speaker: Blake
nodes.text: Later.

nodes.text: Before your first supported team practice.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: I haven't seen you play. That means I owe you a look, and you owe this group your attention.

nodes.text: Being new is hard.

nodes.text: Today: find the player who can see both you and the ball. Keepers, show me a distribution option before you need it.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: After training.

nodes.speaker: Cloudy
nodes.text: Did anyone learn your name, or are we still officially "new kid"?

nodes.text: I found a space once and somebody actually passed it to me.

nodes.text: So. What's the plan for next time?

Take a quiet evening and return tomorrow

nodes.text: Rest is allowed. Training will still be there tomorrow.

nodes.text: Evening, at home.

nodes.text: Can you just listen? No advice.

nodes.text: Why did we have to move?

nodes.text: I miss home.

nodes.text: Let's talk more this weekend. Properly. And let's decide where the old shirt lives in your new room.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Whatever happens with soccer, I love you. That part isn't up for selection.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Weekend. The assessment closes with Coach Code's feedback. Next week: league game 1.

nodes.text: What if I mess it up?

nodes.speaker: Cloudy

nodes.speaker: Cloudy

nodes.text: Nervous means it matters. Choose one small job you can do even when nervous.

nodes.text: In class, Jordan is building a small display for the classroom wall.

nodes.text: Can you help with the project? It's due Friday.

nodes.text: Your job is to help the next action happen. You don't have to make this match your autobiography.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Pass, then find the next useful space. Keepers: reset and support the angle. Both count.
